description: Four representative cam1 raw frames used in Fig. 6 of the paper 'A POD-Based Image Quality Acceptance Framework for Crack Detection in High-Speed Mobile Tunnel Inspection' (IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement). The frames are captured at 0.3 mm/pixel ground sampling distance under the following inspection conditions: (a) 60 km/h, ISO 200, 2.5 m stand-off (best-case); (b) 80 km/h, ISO 200, 4.5 m (typical); (c) 60 km/h, ISO 200, 6.5 m (boundary, LED-strobe-limited); (d) 60 km/h, ISO 1600, 2.5 m (saturated). Each frame shows a test panel with an Imatest eSFR slant-edge chart and a crack-width specimen panel (0.1-1.0 mm). The dataset supports reproducibility of image-quality (IQ) metric measurements (C_M, L_90, MTF50, BEW, sigma_motion) and visibility-based crack-detection outcomes reported in the paper.
